title: Correct AGENTS PR workflow guidance
description: Address review feedback on PR #15: restore the Beads-generated section to generated content and move project-specific merge policy outside the generated block. Clarify that agents push a branch and open a PR for review handoff; merging to main happens after review, not as part of routine handoff.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md no longer places custom PR policy inside the Beads integration generated block; project-owned guidance says work goes through PRs and agents stop at PR handoff unless explicitly asked to merge after review; verification confirms no direct-main-push instruction remains outside generated text.
close_reason: Restored the Beads-generated session-completion block and moved project PR policy to a normal AGENTS.md section. Handoff now stops at an open PR unless the user explicitly asks to merge after review/checks. Verification: git diff --check passed and rg confirmed placement/wording.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Review item 1 accepted: custom PR policy should not be inside the Beads-generated block. Evaluation: AGENTS.md has BEGIN/END BEADS markers, so project-specific merge policy belongs outside them. Review item 2 accepted: routine handoff should stop at an open PR; merging is only on explicit user request after review/checks. Verification: git diff --check -> exit 0; rg confirms Git & PR Workflow outside Beads markers and 'Routine agent handoff stops at an open PR. Do not merge...' wording.
